critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 2596 uses builtin format() on datetime instead of strftime — works because datetime.__format__ delegates to strftime, but strftime is more explicit and safer.
profile_completion() weights sum to 105 (25+15+15+15+15+10+5+5), so 'percent' can exceed 100 if every check is done. Cap at 100 or rebalance weights to 100.

test_iteration7 required -n 0 to pass because parallel workers (loadscope) each mutate the singleton launch_program collection. Consider guarding shared-state tests with @pytest.mark.serial or moving them into one class so all launch mutations run on a single worker. This is a test-hygiene issue, not a product bug.

server.py line 1685 launch_is_active() requires is_active AND start<=now<=end. A launch scheduled for the future with is_active=true returns active=false and not_started=true; UI seems to only look at active. Verify LaunchBanner handles the 'not_started' case (currently observed banner only in active state).
compute_company_plan returns 'expired' only if there's a subscription doc with status expired/cancelled; a company that had no membership but tried before will still be 'free'. Behavior matches spec.

view_candidate_career_profile grants access if company plan is member/launch_free AND profile is public; but if the candidate has already applied or been invited, gating is bypassed — correct behavior for pipeline continuity.

quick_apply consumes quota AFTER checking cv_path but BEFORE creating the application. If application insert throws after quota consume, user loses one quick-apply — extremely unlikely in practice but consider a transaction/compensating decrement.
